mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (indicating an accommodative monetary policy stance) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (based on 10-year rolling data).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals economic weakness that triggers Federal Reserve monetary easing, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.5% within a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.5%) and persistently high federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS above 4.5%) indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance that suppresses corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing boom regime (HOUST above 1400 thousand units), rising home construction activity fuels consumer spending and corporate capital expenditure, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive (year-over-year).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index, 2017=100) signals an economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS above 5.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy stance reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, suppressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0.
